title: CXMT DDR5 and HBM ambitions
summary: China's main DRAM challenger, moving from DDR4 into DDR5 and high-bandwidth memory.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

ChangXin Memory Technologies became China's leading DRAM maker on DDR4 and LPDDR4, and has been sampling DDR5 while working toward high-bandwidth memory for AI accelerators. HBM requires advanced packaging and stacking yields that few firms have mastered, and export controls limit access to some tools. Domestic DRAM matters because memory is the second-largest cost in an AI system after the accelerator.

Status

Attribute Value
Development stage Pilot
Estimated window 2025–2028
Confidence label Researching
Evidence Editorial synthesis of company, agency and press reporting
Compiled 18 November 2026

Related records

Investment Exposure

Memory is where a supply-chain squeeze bites fastest; domestic DRAM capacity is a strategic buffer, not yet a price setter.

What Would Change The View

  • DDR5 qualification at Chinese server makers.
  • Any verified HBM sample.
  • Yield and capital intensity.

Record Notes

Editorial brief, not an imported source note. Named milestones are drawn from company, agency and press reporting; forward dates are announced targets, not verified outcomes. No figure here is an audited statistic.
